criterion: detected before gap filling in at least 50% of HC or of PLWH
why: a feature seen in too few samples of either group cannot be compared; independent of the group difference

criterion: detected before gap filling in more than 70% of usable QCs
why: precision cannot be measured for a feature the pooled QC does not show (Broadhurst et al. 2018)

criterion: relative standard deviation of normalised QC heights at most 30%
why: technical imprecision too large for the feature to be trusted

criterion: SD of log2 QC values over SD of log2 study values at most 50%
why: technical variance too close to the total variance to carry biological information
